Eren Turkoglu

I am currently a backend engineering Intern at Radome. Previously, I worked at Kolizeo, where I helped build products for the sports industry. Before that, at 20, I started a lead generation business. It failed, but it taught me invaluable lessons about copywriting, sales, and communicating with people.

Outside of work, I run DatabaseStory, where I interview database engineers from companies like Google, Microsoft, and AWS to explore their careers, technical challenges, and the lessons they’ve learned along the way.

Projects

In the past, I built the first web version of Kolizeo, an interactive fan engagement platform that enabled sports supporters to play games on the arena’s big screen. The platform was deployed by SLUC Nancy Basket, a historic French professional basketball club.

These are a few of the open source projects I’ve worked on: [My GitHub profile]

  • LSM-Tree storage engine: LSM-Tree storage engine based on RocksDB
  • toy-database: SQLite from scratch in C
  • awesome-database: Curated list of awesome database stories
  • QoreDB: Next Generation Database Client
  • TursoDB: In-process SQL database compatible with SQLite
